test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

We should all__ stays__ united.
solution:
The correct answer is **Stay.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence can be improved by replacing the **"All stays" **with** "Stay."**
 
• The given sentence is in **Simple Present Tense. **
 
• We use the **"Simple Present Tense"** when something is happening right now or frequently.
 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + first form of verb + s/es/ies (with singular verb) + Object.
 
• **Example:** *She needs to do her homework. *
 
 
 
• As** "all"** is a plural verb, **"stay"** should be used instead of "all stays."
 
• Thus, the correct option is **Stay.**

The correct sentence is: **We should stay united. **
